Group labels (sPD-L1 / exoPD-L1 / CTC PD-L1) MUST match the engine's subgroup_map output for `marker_type`; the engine uses identity mapping (no subgroup_map remap), so extracted marker_type values must read exactly 'sPD-L1', 'exoPD-L1', 'CTC PD-L1'.

exoPD-L1 PFS uses the PRE-TREATMENT pooled estimate 4.44 [2.87-6.89] (I2=0%). The OVERALL pooled exoPD-L1 PFS was highly heterogeneous and non-significant: HR 0.97 [0.28-3.37], I2=94% — it mixes opposing pre-treatment (high baseline = worse) and dynamic post-treatment (upregulation = better) directions, so the pre-treatment cell is the interpretable benchmark target.
i2 null where not reported; single-study estimates omitted from primary rows.
